summary: Doggo MVP full-stack test. Backend: 24/24 pytest passing (auth, walks list+filters, walk detail, create walk w/ auto-distance, rate, comment, hazard, confirm walk, profile). Frontend: login, explore map, walk carousel, filter chips + filter modal + apply, toggle-view-mode, walk detail (title, map, confirm-card, 5-star rating, comment posting, open-confirm + confirm-accurate), Search filter, Profile (Marie D., 5 walks + activity), Logout button all work. ONE CRITICAL BUG: Create tab crashes with red screen 'Element type is invalid ... Check render method of CreateScreen' at app/(tabs)/create.tsx:118:13 — `PathIcon` component is undefined (missing/incorrect import).

ui_bugs.issue: Red screen 'Element type is invalid: expected a string ... but got: undefined'. Stack points to line 118:13 inside <Pressable testID='mode-draw'> — the icon component `PathIcon` (used for the draw mode toggle) is undefined. Likely a bad/missing import from lucide-react-native (there is no `PathIcon` export in lucide-react-native — use e.g. `PenTool`, `Pencil`, or `Route` instead). Screen is unusable, blocks entire Create flow.

Password hashing uses SHA-256 with a static salt (`doggo_static_salt_v1`). Fine for MVP demo, but should migrate to bcrypt/argon2 before production.
No rate-limit or auth on POST /api/auth/session — depends on Emergent OAuth trust chain (OK for MVP).

rca_of_issue: Create screen crash — RCA: React error 'Element type is invalid ... got: undefined' means a JSX tag references a variable that is undefined at runtime. The Expo dev-error overlay pinpoints app/(tabs)/create.tsx:118 which is `<PathIcon ... />` inside the mode-draw Pressable. `PathIcon` is not a valid named export of lucide-react-native (checked common icon libraries). Fix: import a real icon and alias it — e.g. `import { Pencil as PathIcon, Radio as RecordIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';` — or replace <PathIcon> with an existing icon component already imported. Reproduction: login → tap 'Create' tab → red screen. Mitigation: change the icon import so the component resolves; confirm no other undefined icons on the same screen.
